name: Yoshioka Hiroto
source:
"Was Nodoka excited by today's swapping...?"

The protagonist of this work.

He is a fairly ordinary middle-aged man who has been very busy lately. Because of that, he has somehow ended up in a sexless relationship. He is aware that he is neglecting his sexual needs due to his busy work schedule.
Subconsciously, he has started to believe things like "as long as there's love, its fine if we don't have sex." 
Its not like he's a serial cheater, since he doesn't have that much experience with women, but he can't say no if a woman actively approaches him.

[Translated from [url=https://www.hs-crowd.co.jp/anim/product/pro_pc/pc036/syoukai.html]the official site[/url]]
